test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement' as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

The number of homes __with running watered__ has been rising sharply since 1985.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2, "with running water."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct form of the verb "**run**" in this context is "**running**."
 
• The preposition "**with**" correctly indicates that the homes have access to running water.
 
• In the original sentence, the word "**watered**" is used **incorrectly**.
 
• "**Has been**" is used in the given sentence which forms the present perfect continuous tense.
 
• The **present perfect continuous** tense is employed in a sentence to indicate an action that started in the recent past and is still continuing in the present.
 
• The correct term is "**running water**," which means a continuous supply of water.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence:** *The number of homes with running water has been rising sharply since 1985.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: "**with run water**," is grammatically incorrect because it uses the wrong form of the verb "run."
 
• Option 3: "**of ran watered**," is also incorrect because it uses the wrong preposition and an unusual verb form.
 
• Option 4: "**No improvement**," is not applicable in this case because the sentence needs improvement.
